features: v11.30: OneDrive, Google Drive, and Dropbox root-level workbook browse/open/save using OAuth PKCE and DPAPI-protected Windows refresh credentials.
v12.0: Persistent Excel 2019, Modern, Compact, and High Contrast appearance presets, independent from light/dark theme and Excel-style/Guided workspace.
v12.0.1: Fixed ribbon sizing; corrected TOCOL/TOROW error-ignore options; improved progress and responsiveness for XLSX, CSV, public CSV query, and cloud workbook imports.
v12.0.2: ChartEx chart XLSX round-trips now preserve supported data-label visibility, collection position, and separator settings.
v12.0.3: XLSX export preserves supported conditional-formatting data-bar gradient and negative-fill settings.
v12.0.3: Chart editor and XLSX import/export support left-side legend placement.
v12.0.4: XLSX parsing, workbook construction and formula import run in a module worker with progress updates.
v12.0.5: Chart error bars support plus, minus, or both directions and optional end caps; standard charts choose gap, zero, or span for blank cells.
v12.0.6: The Draw/Page Layout tabs hide the unused command-ribbon row; DATEVALUE parses localized names, digits, and locale-ordered dates.
v12.0.7: Horizontal bar chart error bars render along the value axis and export as native horizontal DrawingML error bars.
v12.0.8: Scatter charts support X or Y error bars, with automatic axis bounds and XLSX direction round-trip.
v12.0.9: Scatter chart labels honor center, inside-end, outside-end, and best-fit placement.

v12.0.10: Box root-level workbook browse/open/save uses a native desktop bridge to avoid random-origin browser CORS configuration; Box app client secret uses DPAPI, update requests use If-Match, and simple upload is limited to 50 MB.
v12.0.11: XLSX generation for local downloads and explicit cloud saves runs in a module worker, with a workbook preparation status in the interface.

v12.0.12: CSV calculated-value generation and JSON serialization run in a module worker; the interface shows export preparation status. Workbook snapshot creation and native save handoff remain on the interface thread.
v12.0.13: CSV export rejects used areas over 2,000,000 cells and oversized CSV/JSON text with actionable guidance, avoiding accidental huge range expansion.
v12.0.14: CSV file parsing, workbook construction, batch cell edits, and formula calculation run in a module worker with import limits and progress messages.
v12.0.15: GridForge JSON workbook parsing and restoration run in a module worker with progress updates and a 64 MB input limit.
v12.0.16: CSV import applies cell edits in bounded 4,096-cell batches and retains formula references separately to reduce peak working memory.
v12.0.17: Draw and Page Layout use fixed-height direct-child ribbon rows; the empty standard ribbon and inactive specialized ribbon are forcibly hidden to prevent vertical flex expansion.
v12.0.18: Explicit @ implicit intersection of computed arrays returns the top-left item, matching Excel; direct range intersection retains formula-position behavior.

v12.0.19: Date validation and Pivot date paths share Excel 1900-system serial conversion, including serial 60; saved bounds restore correctly and imported 1904-system date-validation bounds are normalized.
v12.0.20: XLSX formulas add `_xlfn.` prefixes to supported newer functions such as REGEXEXTRACT, GROUPBY, PIVOTBY, TRANSLATE, and IMAGE.
v12.0.21: REGEXEXTRACT supports Excel return modes 0/1/2 and case sensitivity, with bounded JavaScript regex semantics.
v12.0.22: XLSX serialization adds `_xlfn.` prefixes for Microsoft 365 FIELDVALUE and STOCKHISTORY formulas.
v12.0.23: XLSX serialization adds `_xlfn.` prefixes for Microsoft 365 PERCENTOF and ISOMITTED, and service-backed DETECTLANGUAGE formulas.
v12.0.24: Draw and Page Layout surfaces receive an inline compact-height lock when selected, preventing ribbon growth from inherited flex styles.
v12.0.25: Workbook formula evaluation adds scoped LAMBDA invocation and supports LAMBDA callbacks in MAP, BYROW, BYCOL, MAKEARRAY, REDUCE, SCAN, and ISOMITTED.
v12.0.26: Formula-based GROUPBY and PIVOTBY gain lambda aggregation, filter arrays, sorting, grand totals, percent-of calculations, and multiple GROUPBY fields.
v12.0.27: Worksheet-local non-recursive named LAMBDA formulas can be invoked directly, passed to lambda-aware functions, and round-trip in XLSX/XLSM defined names.

v12.0.28: Formula-based PIVOTBY supports multiple measure columns; workbook restoration defers duplicate main-thread formula calculation after worker imports; cloud JSON loading also uses the import worker.
v12.0.29: Excel-style Ctrl+PageUp/Ctrl+PageDown worksheet navigation, Shift+F11 sheet insertion, Ctrl+Shift+L filter toggle, and per-sheet active selection/range/scroll restoration.
v12.0.30: Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End move to the beginning and used-area edge; Shift variants extend the selection, using populated or formatted cells to find the used boundary.
v12.0.31: Shift+Space selects the active row, Ctrl+Space selects the active column, and Ctrl+Shift+Space selects the worksheet.
v12.0.32: Name Box navigation selects a single cell, rectangular cell range, or a supported defined name on the active worksheet.
v12.0.33: Ctrl+R fills selected cells to the right from the first selected column, shifting relative formula references while respecting absolute references.
v12.0.34: Ctrl+Arrow moves to populated-region boundaries, including across blank areas; Home moves to the first column in the active row. Shift extends the selection.
v12.0.35: The in-app Keyboard shortcuts panel documents sheet navigation, row/column/full-sheet selection, fill-right, Home/used-area movement, range navigation, and filter shortcuts.
v12.0.36: Name Box navigation supports cross-worksheet cell/range references with quoted sheet names, and resolves sheet-local defined names on that target worksheet.
v12.0.37: Formula-based PIVOTBY supports up to eight row and column field levels, hierarchy header rows, and field/value sorting with multiple measures.
v12.0.38: Formula-based PIVOTBY supports relative_to values 0–4 for column, row, grand, parent-column, and parent-row aggregation bases across hierarchy fields.
v12.0.39: Formula-based PIVOTBY row_sort_order and col_sort_order accept one-dimensional vectors of field positions/directions, with value-column sorting remaining scalar-only.

v12.0.40: Routine autosaves persist workbook snapshots to IndexedDB, migrate existing local-storage workbooks, and use local storage as a fallback when IndexedDB fails. Snapshot construction remains on the UI thread.
v12.0.41: Formula-based PIVOTBY multi-level headers separate column field captions, hierarchy category values, and measure captions into distinct spill rows.
v12.0.42: Formula-based PIVOTBY supports nested row and column subtotals using positive or negative total depths, with hierarchy sort validation and an output-size preflight.
v12.0.43: Formula-based GROUPBY supports nested row subtotals with top or bottom placement, hierarchy-safe sorting, and an output-size preflight.
v12.0.44: Public JSON query refresh can select a nested array with an optional bounded JSON Pointer path before tabular normalization and transformation.
v12.0.45: PIVOTBY builds bounded row and column prefix indexes so subtotal aggregation can find matching groups without rescanning the full group map for each output cell.
v12.0.46: CUBESETCOUNT is now classified as OLAP-dependent and returns #N/A for an unsupported plain-text set instead of counting comma-delimited text.
v12.0.47: External JSON query refresh flattens nested record fields into bounded worksheet columns, with path depth, header length, column count, and ambiguous-name checks.
v12.0.55: Treemap and Sunburst aggregation keys use the full hierarchy tuple instead of a display-delimited label, preserving categories that contain the path separator.
v12.0.56: XLSX error cells import as formula error values; formula errors export with native OOXML error types and all supported scalar formula results retain cached values.
v12.0.57: FIELDVALUE reports #FIELD! when linked Excel data types are unavailable; INFO release and worksheet count reflect the modeled Excel workbook.
v12.0.58: XLSX array formulas import as cached cell values with a warning when GridForge cannot own and recalculate the imported array range.
v12.0.59: INFO(system) reports the detected Windows or macOS runtime using Excel-compatible labels; browser/unknown hosts remain identified as web.
v12.0.60: Recognize Excel #DATA! formula errors and export GridForge-only diagnostics as standard cached #VALUE! errors in OOXML.
v12.0.61: Corrected FORECAST.ETS family argument mapping and common Excel timeline/size/duplicate/step validation, with a documented offline linear approximation.

v12.0.62: Validates FORECAST.ETS missing-data and aggregation option positions, and scales forecast confidence intervals by confidence level, forecast horizon, and linear-fit leverage. These remain approximations, not Excel ETS parity.
v12.0.62: Indexes dynamic formula range dependencies by worksheet column to narrow invalidation work for INDIRECT, OFFSET, and Pivot lookups.
v12.0.63: FILTERXML evaluates XPath in browser hosts with bounded XML size and spills selected node text into cells; other runtimes retain a limited fallback.

v12.0.64: FORECAST.ETS uses bounded additive triple-exponential smoothing for sufficiently long seasonal datasets, with a linear fallback for nonseasonal, short, or oversized data; STAT reports model residual metrics and coefficients when available.

v12.0.65: FORECAST.ETS fills blank observations with zero or interpolation, rejects series with more than 30% missing data, and groups duplicate timeline values using average, sum, count, counta, min, max, or median aggregation codes.
v12.0.66: Draw and Page Layout now use explicit fixed-height grid rows, preventing flex layout expansion from consuming worksheet space.
v12.0.67: Page Setup supports Excel page order Down, then over / Over, then down and preserves it in XLSX worksheet metadata.
v12.0.68: Page Setup adds horizontal and vertical centering options and preserves them through XLSX printOptions metadata.
v12.0.69: Workbook-scoped defined names can be created and edited in the Name Manager, used by formula evaluation, persisted in GridForge documents, and imported/exported through XLSX definedNames.
v12.0.70: Deleting a worksheet rewrites references to it inside workbook-scoped defined names to #REF!, consistent with ordinary formulas.
v12.0.71: XLSX defined-name hidden metadata is preserved for workbook and worksheet scopes, including during XLSM worksheet-name edits.
v12.0.72: Macro-preserving XLSM exports now merge workbook-scoped defined-name additions, edits, and deletions while retaining unrelated workbook names and VBA parts.
v12.0.73: Renaming or deleting a worksheet now updates worksheet-scoped names in every other sheet, preserving references or replacing deleted-sheet references with #REF!.
v12.0.74: Worksheet-scoped defined names accept formulas and constants as well as ranges and LAMBDAs, and XLSX imports retain cross-sheet formula definitions.
v12.0.75: XLSX import validates worksheet-scoped defined names individually, retaining supported names when another definition is unsupported.
v12.0.76: Sparse worksheet bounds increase to 10,000 rows by 256 columns, with a 500,000 populated-cell per-worksheet cap and a 250,000-cell-per-sheet XLSX import cap.
v12.0.77: Full-range clear operations traverse sparse populated or styled cells instead of allocating an edit per blank cell; dense formatting selections have a size guard.
v12.0.78: Clipboard operations enforce a 50,000-cell bound before building snapshots or paste transactions.
v12.0.79: Worksheet charts can be downloaded as 2x PNG images as well as SVG.
v12.0.80: Cloud browsing and save-copy destinations support folder navigation across OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, and Box.
v12.0.81: Cloud download and overwrite APIs reject folder entries and cross-provider update targets before making requests.
v12.0.82: Binary and unary worksheet operators calculate element-wise over bounded dynamic arrays and spill results when dimensions match.
v12.0.83: Box & Whisker charts support Excel-style inclusive/exclusive quartile interpolation, inner-point/outlier visibility, mean markers/lines, and ChartEx import/export metadata round-trip.
v12.0.84: Chart editor supports accessible descriptions exposed in SVG and preserved through XLSX drawing metadata import/export.
v12.0.85: Chart editor accepts accessibility descriptions; SVG output includes accessible names/title/description and XLSX chart drawing metadata preserves bounded descriptions.
v12.0.86: Chart editor adds optional custom data-label number formats, rendered locally and preserved in standard DrawingML and ChartEx numFmt metadata.
v12.0.87: Supported category-based chart types can reverse category order in the renderer and preserve DrawingML axis orientation on import/export.
v12.0.88: View supports freezing rows above and columns left of the active cell and clearing all frozen panes; XLSX pane metadata remains supported.
v12.0.89: XLSX worksheet view export writes activePane metadata for row-only, column-only and combined frozen panes.
v12.0.90: TEXTBEFORE/TEXTAFTER on empty source text correctly use #N/A or the supplied not-found fallback when a non-empty delimiter is missing.
v12.0.91: Supported category-based charts can display a compact data table with optional series keys; standard XLSX chart data-table settings import and export natively.

v12.0.92: Chart Design can show hidden rows and columns in supported standard charts; standard DrawingML plotVisOnly settings now round-trip, and previews honor hidden rows, hidden columns, and filters by default.
v12.0.93: NUMBERVALUE uses current-locale decimal and grouping marks by default, normalizes locale digits, respects explicit separators, and validates whitespace grouping around the decimal mark.
v12.0.94: VALUE and NUMBERVALUE share a cached locale-aware parser for decimal/group marks and localized digits; NUMBERVALUE retains explicit separator and repeated-percent handling.
v12.0.95: VALUE accepts supported locale date and time text, including combined date-time serials; TIMEVALUE and VALUE share a locale-digit-aware time parser.
v12.0.96: VALUE additionally recognizes one leading or trailing currency symbol around locale-formatted numeric text; NUMBERVALUE keeps its independent syntax.
v12.0.97: TIMEVALUE ignores a valid locale-formatted date prefix and returns the time portion, following Excel's documented date-time input behavior.
v12.0.98: TIME rejects negative and greater-than-32767 hour/minute/second fields; valid over-24-hour and over-59-minute/second values continue to roll over.

v12.0.99: HOUR, MINUTE, and SECOND parse supported time text with the same localized-digit-aware clock parser used by TIMEVALUE; currency parsing rejects symbol-only text rather than converting it to zero.
v12.0.100: Chart data-table SVG exposes table/row/header/cell accessibility roles and complete cell labels while retaining compact visual truncation.
v12.0.101: Shared time text parsing recognizes the current locale's clock separator and day-period words, retains ASCII AM/PM and colon input, and caches locale rules.

v12.0.102: Draw Select Objects supports Ctrl/Shift multi-selection, group movement, multi-delete and multi-object color/width edits; Ctrl+D duplicates selected drawings with bounded offset and worksheet resource checks.

v12.0.103: Draw object multi-selection adds screen-reader names, keyboard focus, Space/Enter selection, and Ctrl/Shift multi-select; linear trendline fitting centers observations and uses compensated sums to retain precision for large X values.

v12.0.104: IRR and RATE now follow Excel-documented 20-iteration guess-driven convergence limits; XIRR uses a 100-iteration guess-driven solver rather than a fallback bracket search, preserving which root the starting estimate selects.

v12.0.105: NPV now ignores nonnumeric values inside worksheet references, filters array inputs to numeric cash flows, skips reference errors, and advances discount periods only for counted numeric entries.
v12.0.106: COUNT, COUNTA, and COUNTBLANK now apply their distinct Excel range/error rules; Data Studio and saved query steps add locale-aware date, time, and date-time text conversion.
v12.0.107: COUNTIF-family criteria now coerce empty-cell references to zero. SUMIF and AVERAGEIF align mismatched result ranges from their top-left cell to the criteria-range dimensions.
v12.0.108: Conditional aggregation criteria now recognize locale-parsed date, time, and combined date-time text when comparing to numeric serial values.

v12.0.109: MAXIFS and MINIFS now coerce empty-cell criterion references to zero and validate the full row/column shape of all reference ranges; COUNTIFS, SUMIFS, and AVERAGEIFS enforce the 127 criteria-pair limit.
v12.0.110: Internal hyperlinks and HYPERLINK formulas can resolve defined names targeting single cells or contiguous ranges across worksheets.
v12.0.111: COUNT, COUNTA, and COUNTBLANK local-reference ranges aggregate sparse stored cells and spill values rather than walking every blank position.
v12.0.112: COUNTIF local-reference ranges compare stored cells and spill values, while computing matches for unpopulated cells from the range area.
v12.0.113: COUNTIFS local-reference ranges compare stored cells and spill values, while computing matching unpopulated cells from the shared range dimensions.
v12.0.114: SUMIFS and AVERAGEIFS local-reference paths visit populated result cells only and validate criteria-range dimensions.
v12.0.115: MAXIFS and MINIFS local-reference paths visit populated result cells only and validate criteria-range dimensions.
v12.0.116: Sparse conditional aggregations preserve the existing error propagation of referenced local ranges.
v12.0.117: Local formula range dependencies are stored compactly and indexed by column for edit invalidation.
v12.0.118: Formula tracing expands compact range dependencies into a bounded set of highlighted cells.
v12.0.119: Spill-cycle detection and dynamic dependency tracking account for compact range dependencies.
v12.0.120: Selected local sparse aggregations can reference ranges up to the configured worksheet area.
v12.0.121: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, and MAX aggregate populated local cells directly for large ranges, preserving overlapping range arguments and cell errors.
v12.0.122: Sparse local aggregations use a per-column populated-row index to avoid allocating a worksheet-wide key set for each calculation.
v12.0.123: MEDIAN, LARGE, and SMALL evaluate large local reference ranges from populated numeric cells without building dense range matrices.
v12.0.124: PRODUCT, STDEV, and VAR join the sparse local numeric aggregation path for large reference ranges.
v12.0.125: Existing STDEV.S, VAR.S, STDEV.P, and VAR.P formula names now use sparse local-range evaluation.

v12.0.126: Specialized ChartEx imports validate series count and connected category/value ranges; unsupported layouts or inconsistent source shapes are reported and skipped to prevent silent chart data changes.
notes: Cloud providers require user-owned public OAuth app registrations.
Cloud browsing is supported in the Windows desktop app only; folder navigation, 80 MB cap, Google drive.file scope, and Box's 50 MB simple-upload cap apply.
No automated tests, live UI, or Windows runtime checks were run.
